name: Fried Chicken and Fried Potatoes
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 ½ lbs chicken, cut into small pieces

steps: Peel potatoes, and slice into small or large wedges.
Heat oil in a pan to about 350°F. Fry potatoes in oil until they are light brown. Once done, salt the potatoes to desired level.
Fry the chicken for about 5 minutes. Drain the oil or move the chicken to a different pan.
Salt the chicken, add ¾ cup of water and let simmer for 15–20 minutes.
Combine chicken and potatoes (potatoes on top).
Add cumin and let simmer for about 20 minutes.

culture.text: The potato is a starchy tuberous vegetable native to the Americas that is consumed as a staple food in many parts of the world. Potatoes are underground stem tubers of the plant Solanum tuberosum, a perennial in the nightshade family Solanaceae.
